name: web-green-project-management-dashboard-with-hatched-bars-and-progress-arc
title: Green Project Management Dashboard
whatItIs: A rounded white dashboard with a sidebar (menu, general, download app card), a search bar and profile, four KPI cards (a dark green Total Projects card and three white), a pill bar chart with hatched bars, a reminders card with a Start Meeting button, a project list, team collaboration with status pills, a hatched progress arc chart and a dark green time tracker.
whatItMeans: Hatched bars and arcs give charts texture, and deep green with white feels calm and productive.
techniques: Half-ring progress arc with hatched pending segment
One dark green KPI card among white
Dark time tracker card with a wave texture
Status pills in soft semantic colours

vocabulary.definition: A diagonal-line pattern used to mark unfinished or secondary data.
A card showing a key metric and change.
